test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which sport is NOT played in mixed doubles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Handball**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Handball** is not played in mixed doubles format.
 
• Mixed doubles is a format where teams are made up of one male and one female player.
 
• Sports such as **tennis, table tennis, and badminton** have mixed doubles events.
 
• Handball, on the other hand, is typically played in single-gender teams or mixed teams, but not in a mixed doubles format.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tennis** mixed doubles is played in major tournaments like Wimbledon, the US Open, etc.
 
• **Table tennis** mixed doubles is an event in the Olympics and World Championships.
 
• **Badminton** mixed doubles is also featured in the Olympics and other major international competitions.
 
• The concept of mixed doubles promotes gender inclusivity and teamwork in sports.
